view.summary: Read the Rapture’s hints and answer each with the right attack or defence button; correct answers deal damage, block attacks and charge a Burst Skill.

overview.title: How it plays
items: Each turn the Rapture shows one to three hints. Pick the matching buttons before time runs out. Attack hints (core or a side part exposed) let you hit it; defence hints (missiles, beams) must be blocked or you take damage.
Easy Raptures only expose their core or fire missiles; Normal adds the left and right parts; Hard adds left and right beams and up to three actions per turn.
Every right answer fills the Burst Gauge (1,000, or 1,500 for a PERFECT, out of 25,000). When it is full, the character’s Burst Skill deals heavy damage.
Each successful defence adds a charge that boosts your next attack (+10% per charge); a wrong answer resets it.
Bring the Rapture’s HP to 0 before yours runs out. Clearing an Easy, Normal or Hard stage gives Trait Points.
An endless run against ever stronger Raptures; your highest damage counts for the Union ranking.
